summary: Aligned memory allocator wrapper used by NhMalloc. Rounds the requested size up to a 16-byte boundary and dispatches on OS-version code dword_8D4908: code 3 sub-allocates small blocks (size <= dword_8D4900) from a pool via sub_59416F under critical section 9; code 2 pulls 16-byte blocks from a block pool (index size/16, bounded by dword_5E998C) via sub_594C12; any other code or an oversized request falls back to HeapAlloc(hHeap, 0, rounded). Every pool path falls back to HeapAlloc when it returns null.

local_names.v3: aligned size base for the fallback path
local_names.v5: pool allocation from the code-3 path
local_names.v6: pool allocation from the code-2 path

operations.description: If OS-version code dword_8D4908 == 3, take the code-3 sub-allocation path.
On the code-3 path, sub-allocate only when a1 <= dword_8D4900; larger requests fall through to the shared HeapAlloc fallback.
Enter critical section 9, call sub_59416F(a1) for the pool sub-allocation, then leave critical section 9.
If the code-3 pool allocation returned non-null, return it immediately; otherwise fall through to the shared HeapAlloc fallback.
If OS-version code dword_8D4908 != 2, use the shared fallback: round a1 up to a 16-byte multiple and HeapAlloc.
Shared fallback size: base = a1, or 1 when a1 is zero; v4 = (base + 15) with the low nibble cleared to align to 16.
Fallback allocation through the HeapAlloc global (0x0059E1C0) on heap hHeap.
Code-2 path: aligned size v2 = a1 rounded up to a 16-byte multiple, or 16 when a1 is zero.
Code-2 path: if aligned size v2 exceeds the block-pool cap dword_5E998C, bypass the pool and HeapAlloc(hHeap, 0, v2).
Enter critical section 9, call sub_594C12(v2 / 16) to fetch the pool block by index, then leave critical section 9.
Code-2 path: if the pool returned null, fall back to HeapAlloc(hHeap, 0, v2).
Return the pool block, or the HeapAlloc result when any pool path failed.
